description: This file is a script that wraps the startup process for a web development environment, handling different modes for Continuous Integration (CI) environments and local development. It detects CI environments, sanitizes environment variables, and conditionally runs a static server or the development server accordingly.

methods.name: isCI
methods.description: Detects if the current environment is a Continuous Integration environment based on environment variables.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Synchronously executes a command with arguments, inheriting stdio and passing current environment variables.
